newsitem.title: USA: US Rep Saxton asks anti-inflation be main Fed goal.
newsitem.headline: US Rep Saxton asks anti-inflation be main Fed goal.

text.p: Joint Economic Committee Chairman Jim Saxton on Thursday introduced legislation that mandates that price stability should be the focus of Federal Reserve monetary policy.
"This legislation mandates price stability and low inflation that is needed for optimal economic and employment growth," Rep. Saxton said.
"With a number of foreign central banks already guided by price stability goals, it's time we let the Federal Reserve operate in an up-to-date manner," the New Jersey Republican said.
